interpretation: Existing simulator updates first-unlock query state but omits the original asynchronous transition report. Original early-starting services can queryfalse and await first_unlock indefinitely. Complete receiver-to-original-producer evidence identifies a narrow missing protocol completion; actual ScreenTime callback recovery remains to be executed.
limits: No fabricated notifyd post or unconditional unlock event is proposed. A future protocol completion would need original consumer proof and only report a real accepted false-to-true transition; rejected/repeated operations and state queries must not produce it. No permission or property expansion follows from this evidence.
